name: New Chitose Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways, 01R/19L and 01L/19R, each 3,000 m x 60 m

hours.v: operating hours 24 hours; business aviation centre (HBAC) reception 08:00-20:00

ppr.v: business aircraft centre use is applied for through the operator's portal; prior registration needed
ppr.quote: Applications are accepted through the portal site. Prior registration is required to apply.

notes: Read Hokkaido Airports' business aviation pages 'ABOUT RJCC / CTS' and FAQ (undated; read 26 Nov 2026). The FAQ says CIQ is included in the HBAC basic fee but CIQ must be contacted directly; no CIQ hours given; fuel bought separately from a fuel supplier. Night-time (22:00-07:00) slot limits are not stated by the operator or MLIT pages read; the MLIT Tokyo Regional Civil Aviation Bureau page (cab.mlit.go.jp/tcab/conditions/01_hokkaido/04.Shinchitose.pdf) shows runway A 3,000 m x 60 m but its hours field was unclear. The MLIT business-jet procedures PDF (mlit.go.jp/koku/content/001762020.pdf) could not be fetched (permission not answered).
